sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:37)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone, 2x Cameras. 1x body camera charger reported missing.
Arrived on site and geared up for patrol.
Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Queen Street, 77 Convenience Store, and Localito Convenience Store. All clear. Proceeded towards Aotea Square.
Aotea Square checked. All clear. Security presence maintained.
Proceeded towards Federal Street via Wellesley Street.
Arrived at Victoria Street and Federal Street.
Welfare checks completed at News Agency Store, Eighty Fed, and both 77 Convenience Stores. All clear.
Response call from Jo & Joe regarding a male in a yellow and blue puffer jacket banging on their windows. Guards proceeded to assist.

Located the POI in the middle of the road at Queen Street and Shortland Street attempting to grab a person riding an e-scooter. He responded in a hostile manner, continued approaching pedestrians, and lightly struck a pedestrian with his jumper. Guards de-escalated and he moved along. Council compliance advised the POI appeared mentally unstable. Guards monitored him towards Fort Street and stood down after no further aggressive behaviour. Video provided. Security presence maintained at Jo & Joe.
Welfare checks completed at Wilson Carpark, 77 Convenience Store Fort Street, Coffee Club, Tribe, and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store Customs Street, McDonald’s Britomart, and Commercial Bay. All clear.
Proceeded to headquarters to meet with Team B.
Team A and Team B attended office briefing. Ops phone placed on charge.
Patrol recommenced. Team A covered the lower CBD; Team B covered the upper CBD.
High Street checked. All clear. Proceeded to O’Connell Street.
O’Connell Street and Freyberg Square checked. All clear. Proceeded to Chancery Square.
Chancery Square checked. All clear. Security presence maintained.
Welfare checks completed at Shortland Street, Pocket Park, Fort Lane, Fort Street, Jo & Joe, Right Track, Vape Haven, Vapor Kings, 77 Convenience Store, and Wilson Carpark. All clear.
Gore Street, Tribe, Chargrill, and Auckland Harbour Suites checked. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store, St Pierre’s Sushi, Custom Mart, and McDonald’s Britomart. All clear.
Moved along a female vagrant seated in front of the old Dangerfield location on Queen Street. Video provided.
Fire reported at the rubbish bin outside Cotton On. Photo provided.
Welfare checks completed at Woolworths Victoria Street, News Agency Store, Subway, Hell Pizza, The Fiddler, Kebab Time, Eighty Fed, and both 77 Convenience Stores. All clear.
Proceeded towards Wyndham Street via Federal Street.
Cathedral checked. All clear. Security presence maintained.
Call from Cotton On regarding a suspicious individual. Team B informed.
Returned to headquarters to assist manager.
Call from Cotton On requesting HOTC presence regarding a POI for deterrence. Team B informed.
Call advising the POI had left Cotton On with no items. Team B asked to attend and show presence.
Call from Auckland Council Wardens requesting HOTC issue a trespass to vagrants loitering in front of the old Dangerfield location on Queen Street.
Proceeded to issue a verbal trespass as no formal notices were available.
Verbal trespass issued. Guards maintained presence and monitored the vagrants until they left.
Returned to headquarters to charge the Ops phone, complete Auror reports, and stand by for shift changeover.
Ops phone placed on charge at 7%. Photo provided.
Auror reports completed. Reports sent via WhatsApp and morning shift signed off.

sections.title: Day Shift — Team 2 (09:40 – 17:00)
items: Team 2 commenced patrols towards Aotea Square. Welfare checks on Queen Street stores between Victoria Street and Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square check-in. Welfare checks completed. All clear.
Aotea Square sweep completed. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Mayoral Drive. Welfare check completed with Te Waihorotiu train station guard. All clear.
Arrived at top of Victoria Street. Welfare checks completed at 77 Convenience Store, Amelia’s Cafe, Mr Tacos, V Phix Mobiles, Coffee Club, Subway, AA Insurance, and Sky Mart. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Victoria Street West. Welfare checks completed at Scrunchy Millers, Surf n Turf Backpackers, Belgar Barbers, Woolworths, Chemist Warehouse, Mecca, and ANZ. All clear.
Arrived at Lorne Street check-in. Full sweep commenced towards Auckland Library.
Arrived at Auckland Library. Full sweep and welfare checks completed. All clear.
Arrived outside Ava Chi Chicken. Security presence maintained.
Returned to headquarters for HOTC meeting.
Routes recommenced up Victoria Street East.
Arrived outside Patch. Security presence maintained.
Arrived at Wellesley Street corner. Security presence maintained.
Arrived outside Elliott Stables. Welfare check completed. All clear. Stood by on Elliott Street.
Response call from morning shift regarding a suspicious female inside Cotton On Queen Street. Team 2 asked to attend and maintain presence.
Arrived at Cotton On. Manager advised the female was paying for the items. Team 2 stood by.
Morning shift advised they were going on break; coverage required for both lower and upper Queen Street routes. Patrolled down towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare checks completed, including McDonald’s Britomart. All clear.
Commercial Bay sweep completed. Response call from morning shift regarding suspicious females inside Cotton On Queen Street.
Arrived at Cotton On Queen Street. Manager advised the females had left and nothing had been taken. Stood by.
Arrived outside BNZ Queen Street. Observed heavy foot traffic on Fort Street due to a fire drill. Stood by in case wardens required assistance.
Full sweep commenced along Fort Street down to Gore Street with welfare checks.
Arrived outside Auckland Harbour Suites. Welfare checks completed down to Gore Street. All clear.
Arrived at bottom of Albert Street. Welfare checks completed at Albert Mart and Remarkable Gifts. All clear.
Arrived at Albert Street and Victoria Street West. Welfare checks completed. Returned to headquarters for briefing with afternoon shift.
Briefing with afternoon shift completed. Stood by charging Ops phone due to low battery.
Response call from afternoon shift regarding a male not complying after being asked by the manager to leave the front of Vape Haven. Assistance requested.
Arrived at Vape Haven. Male had already vacated the premises.
While patrolling, the Vape Haven male vagrant was spotted outside Pop Mart. Team spoke with him and asked him not to return to Vape Haven, shadowing him from a distance. Bodycam footage captured.
Returned to headquarters for final 30-minute break.
Break completed. Stood by, remaining vigilant for response calls.
Team 2 afternoon shift completed. Equipment returned: 1x Camera, 1x Radio, 2x Vests.

sections.title: Afternoon/Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:11)
items: Equipment received: 4x Keys, 2x Swipe Cards, 2x Vests, 1x Ops Phone.
Afternoon shift arrived and stood by while morning shift completed Auror and patrol reports.
Morning shift finished and signed off. Afternoon shift deployed after debrief with Team B.
Debrief completed with Team 2. Guards geared up.
Patrols commenced towards Commercial Bay with welfare checks along the way.
Arrived at Commercial Bay. Welfare check completed at McDonald’s Britomart and Queen Street stores. All clear.
Response call from Kiwiana regarding a suspicious male individual inside the store with a scooter.
Arrived at Kiwiana. Guards asked the individual to vacate the premises. Security presence maintained in case he returned.
Guards took cover due to weather conditions while continuing patrol under shelter.
Security presence maintained at McDonald’s Queen Street.
Patrol commenced through Queen Street towards Elliott Street with welfare checks on stores.
Response call from 125 Queen Street regarding a male sleeping outside the shop who did not comply when asked to vacate by security. Assistance requested.
Arrived at 125 Queen Street. Guards approached the vagrant sleeping on the sidewalk; he left the location. Security presence maintained. Bodycam footage captured.
Patrol continued down Queen Street towards Commercial Bay. Welfare checks completed at McDonald’s Britomart, Commercial Bay, and surrounding stores.
Patrol continued up Albert Street maintaining visible presence.
Patrol commenced down Wyndham Street. Chemist Warehouse checked. All clear.
Returned to headquarters to charge Ops phone at 8%.
Response call from McDonald’s Queen Street regarding a female vagrant outside the door begging and asking for food. On arrival she had already left.
Patrol continued up Queen Street maintaining visible presence.
Sweep completed down Lorne Street; a few vagrants observed and no issues to report.
Response call from Cotton On Queen Street regarding a vagrant who had stolen a jacket. Guards swept the area but did not locate the suspect. Security presence maintained.
Full sweep of High Street commenced.
Fire reported on Fort Lane with fire trucks outside the building. Guards stood by to maintain presence. Footage captured on Ops phone.

Observed a male vagrant yelling and being aggressive towards Asian members of the public and another vagrant. Guards asked him to calm down; he initially did but began hitting properties and objects. Guards followed for ~5 minutes, called 111 with a full description. Police arrived ~2 minutes later and arrested the vagrant.
A group of members of the public were seen with open cans of alcohol. Guards asked them to dispose of the cans, which were retrieved. Patrol continued through Commercial Bay.

Encountered a vagrant consuming alcohol on Albert Street. When approached he became verbally aggressive and refused to dispose of his alcohol. Guards issued a verbal warning regarding alcohol in the CBD and he moved off.

Welfare check completed at Chatime, top of Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at McDonald’s Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Victoria Street and top of High Street.
Full sweep completed around Freyberg Square and Chancery Square. All clear.
Security presence maintained at Freyberg Square for nearby calls.
Patrol completed through O’Connell Street, bottom of High Street, Fort Street, and White Lady. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Gore Street and Auckland Harbour Suites. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Britomart and Commercial Bay. All clear.
Welfare check completed at carpark next to Chemist Warehouse. All clear.
Upper Queen Street checked. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Aotea Square and Mayoral Drive. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store on Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Albert Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Customs Street and Custom Mart Convenience Store. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Fort Lane, Fort Street, and Jo & Joe. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at High Street and High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Chancery Square, Freyberg area, and upper High Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at Lorne Street and Auckland Library. All clear.
Checks completed at Darby Street and Elliott Street. All clear.
Patrol completed up Victoria Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store. All clear.
Patrol completed along Federal Street towards Wyndham Street. All clear.
Patrol completed down Wyndham Street towards Queen Street. All clear.
Welfare checks completed at Q Convenience Store and Custom Mart. All clear.
Patrol completed through Fort Lane, Fort Street, and bottom of High Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at High Street Supermarket. All clear.
Full sweep completed around Chancery Square and Freyberg Square. All clear.
Welfare check completed at bottom of Hobson Street. All clear.
Welfare check completed at 77 Convenience Store at top of Victoria Street. All clear.
Patrol completed down Victoria Street towards Queen Street and Lorne Street. All clear.
Handover to morning shift completed. Night shift concluded.
